home.disclaimer_text: The website is using a grain overlay which may make the clips look grainy but in reality they should be clean unless it was made to look that way.
home.faq_a1: Yes, our website is completely safe. We do not host malicious ads or files.
home.faq_a2: Active Packs are collections of anime that are currently airing or recently finished.
home.faq_q3: What format are the anime clips?
home.faq_a3: Most clips are provided in high-quality MKV or MP4 format.
home.faq_q4: When do you release new anime clips?
home.faq_a4: We update our database daily with new releases and requests.
home.faq_q5: There are no clips/missing episodes on the anime page?
home.faq_a5: We are constantly updating our library. If something is missing, it will likely be added soon.
home.faq_q6: How do you encode (render) the anime clips?
home.faq_a6: We use high-efficiency codecs to ensure the best quality with the smallest file size.
home.faq_q7: I get the error Network Failed after downloading a folder?
home.faq_a7: This usually happens due to unstable internet connection. Please try downloading individual files.
